data.title: Three-pounder "grasshopper" cannon.
data.description: A Three-pounder cannon sits alone in a field.
data.altText: A three-pounder "grasshopper" cannon made of bronze and a carriage made of blue-painted wood sits in a field under the shade of a tree during the early morning hours.
